## Summary and General Analysis
- Guinaifen has a chance to apply "Firekiss" to any enemies taking damage from Burn, which applies Vulnerability to any affected enemies.
- Using her Ultimate on enemies inflicted with Burn will detonate any existing Fire DoT applied

## Noteable Investments
 ### E1, E4, E6
- Her E1 increases the chance for allies to apply debuffs.
- E4 Makes her gains extra Energy from enemies she has inflicted with Burn take damage.
- Her E6 provides more damage to the team by increasing the amount of "Firekiss" stacks she can apply by 1.

## Ability Rotation
- [[ability:skill]] → Basic ATK
- Skill spam if Skill Points are available
